title: ContactPreferenceSlot
description: The customer API's slot: how the customer wants to be contacted.

email.description: Email address to contact the customer at.

preferredLanguage.description: Language to contact the customer in (ISO 639-1).

contactTime.description: When the customer prefers to be contacted, as they said it, e.g. weekday mornings.

marketingConsent.description: Whether the customer agreed to be contacted about other products.

updatedDate.description: Date the customer last changed their preferences.
